title: Paleocraft: Dinosaur Breakout
creator: Marketplace Creator
description:
Dinosaurs have escaped and are roaming free!

Survive in a dinosaur world and encounter prehistoric creatures; from the famous T-Rex to the immense Brachiosaurus, the iconic Carnotaurus to the obscure Pterodaustro.
This Add-On features returning classics from the original Paleocraft as well as a range of new species!

More than 50 creatures and vehicles in total!

title: More TNT! Add-On
creator: Marketplace Creator

title: Spark Portals Add-On

description: Teleport across all dimensions of your world to travel around faster than ever. Craft portals in all Minecraft colors and link them together to create up to 160 portals in any of your worlds. Watch the trailer to see how!

- Find traders selling fruits to power up your dragon's speed, health, and firepower!
- Lite has 8 dragons to collect!

APPLY TO ANY WORLD!
